governing.label: SGLT2 inhibitors vs placebo, Mantel-Haenszel random effects
governing.quote: compared with control group (RR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.53 to 0.74; P < 0.00001) ( Figure 2 )

quotes.quote: Eight randomized controlled trials that compared SGLT-2i versus placebo met our inclusion criteria

scope.reading: Its 8 rows are the 4 broad cardiovascular outcome trials we pool (EMPA-REG OUTCOME, the CANVAS Program, DECLARE-TIMI 58, VERTIS CV -- all shared), plus DAPA-HF and EMPEROR-Reduced (heart-failure entry) and CREDENCE (kidney-disease entry), which our protocol excludes by entry criterion, and Kosiborod 2017, a pooled analysis rather than a trial (below).
scope.reported_by: external review of the sglt2-primary-prevention-hf topic (28 Sep 2026)

caption.quote: Heart failure hospitalization in type 2 diabetes patients receiving SGLT2 inhibitors versus control.

figure.read_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (lane evid2), from the held image, 28 Sep 2026; participant totals 31,172 / 24,591 and event totals 1,100 / 1,436 match the plot

input_type.quote: Data for patients randomized to dapagliflozin 10mg or placebo with a history of HF were pooled from five clinical trials.
input_type.reading: a post-hoc analysis of heart-failure patients pooled from five glycaemic trials (171 vs 149), not a trial; the comparator enters it as an RCT row.

source_check.quote: hospitalization for heart failure occurred in a significantly lower percentage of patients treated with empagliflozin [126/4687 patients (2.7%)] than with placebo [95/2333 patients (4.1%)]
source_check.reading: the plot gives empagliflozin placebo's events and placebo empagliflozin's: the numerators are swapped between arms, turning a 35% reduction into a 62% one. Recorded, never copied; our EMPA-REG hazard ratio (0.65, 0.50-0.85) is correct and is never altered to match.
